name: 夫が妻の姓を選ぶとき、それぞれの声

p_8f6de24eb2.sentence: I was thankful that both our parents accepted my choice and did not take it badly.
p_8f6de24eb2.prev: They asked me again and again if I was really sure.
p_8f6de24eb2.next: I still find it a little hard to have less time to myself while living at my wife's parents' home.

p_ad9e388f65.sentence: That relative took his wife's last name without talking it over with his parents first.
p_ad9e388f65.prev: If my son chose it, I wouldn't stop him, but I do think about one of my relatives.
p_ad9e388f65.next: I know his mother, my aunt, was so shocked that she became unwell.

p_bb5820f386.sentence: Even so, I don't want my feelings as a parent to hold my son back.
p_bb5820f386.prev: I say the couple should decide for themselves, but that still bothers me.
p_bb5820f386.next: If he talked to me before choosing a last name, I could tell him how I feel.

p_785051cf57.sentence: When your name changes after marriage, you think about the name you know.
p_785051cf57.prev: What Each Person Says When a Husband Takes His Wife’s Last Name
p_785051cf57.next: You also think about your family, don't you?

p_fae064e925.sentence: He took his wife's last name as an adopted son-in-law.
p_fae064e925.next: He lives with his family in his wife's parents' home.

p_aa1f7daea1.sentence: I still find it a little hard to have less time to myself while living at my wife's parents' home.
p_aa1f7daea1.prev: I was thankful that both our parents accepted my choice and did not take it badly.
p_aa1f7daea1.next: But it was harder to get used to each family's daily ways than to change my last name.

p_6f9b2bdca8.sentence: I have to let my son go, don't I?
p_6f9b2bdca8.prev: Someone said that was old-fashioned, and I thought they were right.
p_6f9b2bdca8.next: I still feel sad, but I want to accept his choice to take his wife's last name.

p_a500be97c0.sentence: Changing my last name was no problem for me.
p_a500be97c0.prev: I became an adopted son-in-law, and I use my wife's family name.
p_a500be97c0.next: My family comes from a rural area, but they are not old-fashioned.

p_5bcd43ee9c.sentence: Her son is getting married next year.
p_5bcd43ee9c.next: She felt sad when she heard he would take his wife's last name.

p_9ba97332d1.sentence: My family comes from a rural area, but they are not old-fashioned.
p_9ba97332d1.prev: Changing my last name was no problem for me.
p_9ba97332d1.next: My parents accepted my choice right away.

p_f932b7703a.sentence: Or he may become her adopted son-in-law.
p_f932b7703a.prev: A husband may choose his wife's last name on the marriage form.
p_f932b7703a.next: People have different feelings about this.

p_cd738ebdb1.sentence: Finally, we hear from someone in the parents' generation.
p_cd738ebdb1.prev: I also want to keep some distance from his wife and put the couple's happiness first.
p_cd738ebdb1.next: A relative of theirs chose his wife's last name.

p_d89972fe17.sentence: A relative of theirs chose his wife's last name.
p_d89972fe17.prev: Finally, we hear from someone in the parents' generation.
p_d89972fe17.next: Their children have not married yet.

p_d720d9c173.sentence: I know his mother, my aunt, was so shocked that she became unwell.
p_d720d9c173.prev: That relative took his wife's last name without talking it over with his parents first.
p_d720d9c173.next: Still, if my son's future wife's parents thought it was only natural, it would bother me.
